c: On an incident assigned to you, choose Reset Password. Agents need the password_reset_service_desk role.
say: On an incident assigned to you, choose reset password in the action bar. You need the service desk password reset role.

c: Select user and Select password reset process, then Continue to verify. On pdi2 no service-desk process is active yet.
say: Select the user and the password reset process, then continue to verify. On pdi2, no service desk process is active yet, so this is where it stops today.

c: Ask the caller for their email address; the tab shows what the answer should be. Continue or Reject.
say: Ask the caller for their email address. The tab shows what the answer should be. Continue if it matches, or reject.

c: Reset password also unlocks the account; Unlock account only unlocks it.
say: Choose reset password, which also unlocks the account, or unlock account if that is all they need.

c: Read the generated password using the Phonetic reading, tick I have read the password to the user. It is also emailed; they change it at next login.
say: Read the generated password to the caller, using the phonetic reading, and confirm you have. It is also emailed to them, and they must change it at their next login.

c: After 3 failed verifications the caller is blocked from password reset for 24 hours.
say: After three failed verifications, the caller is blocked from password reset for a day. Don't keep trying.
